author: Mantercmg
body:
A new Nebula, map, which me and In_Arte cobbled together in less than 24 hours. I built it for two reasons. 
1. Many people who have less powerful PCs, are complaining about the new maps being laggy, due to their very detailed surrondings. I personally do not like the new detailed maps. This map is about gameplay, not design. Consider this, people who judge this map. 
2. I wanted to do multiple level maps. You have a choice on what to get. Will you get diamonds, the enchantment table or just... nothing on the top?
The whole map.
Middle of the map.Green end.
Purple end
Single Enchanting table... Will you get or will the other team get it?
Nothing here... XD
